personalInfo.name: Harsh Gopwar
personalInfo.title: Full Stack Developer
personalInfo.bio: I am a passionate full-stack developer with a strong background in building modern, scalable web applications. Lets collaborate andbring your ideas to life.

projects.title: Daawat — Restaurant & Food Ordering Platform
projects.description: A responsive restaurant website designed to provide a complete online food-ordering experience. Users can browse the menu, register or log in, add food items to their cart, manage quantities, enter delivery details, and place orders through a frontend-based ordering workflow.

projects.title: Cultural Heritage - Historical Destination Website
projects.description: A modern and responsive cultural heritage website designed to showcase historical destinations, cultural attractions, and heritage experiences. The website focuses on clean navigation, engaging visual presentation, responsive layouts, and an intuitive user experience across desktop and mobile devices.

projects.title: ELearning — Online Learning Platform
projects.description: A responsive e-learning platform designed to provide users with an organized and engaging online learning experience. The website includes course browsing, course information, user authentication pages, registration, and a structured interface for accessing educational content.

keyResponsibilities: Led a team of developers to create scalable web applications.
Implemented RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Express.
Developed front-end applications using React and Next.js.
Integrated third-party services and APIs to enhance application functionality.
Mentored junior developers and conducted code reviews.
Designed and developed PCB layouts based on circuit schematics and design requirements.
Created and modified PCB schematics and layouts using EDA/CAD software.
Worked with Through-Hole Technology (THT) components and ensured proper component placement and routing.
Performed design checks and prepared PCB layouts for manufacturing and assembly.
Supported PCB testing and troubleshooting using Flying Probe Testing.
Collaborated with engineering and production teams to resolve design and manufacturing issues.
